query:
UPDATE access.login_sessions
                SET session_epoch = $5, auth_time_ms = $6, assurance = $7,
                    step_up_ms = CASE WHEN $8 THEN $6 ELSE step_up_ms END
              WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2 AND session_id = $3 AND ended_ms IS NULL
                AND session_epoch = $4
